Emails

Kempo does not send email itself: an email extension (such as kempo-resend or kempo-smtp) does, and its settings are on its own tab here. How long the log is kept, and how many times a failed email is tried again, are on the System tab of Settings.

Log Templates Styles

Every email the site was asked to send, and what happened to it.

Every email the site sends: kempo's own, and each extension's. Open one to see the variables it can use, choose the stylesheet it is drawn with, and reword it. Your copy is used from the next email on, and Reset to default brings the packaged one back.
